key.name: format-string
key.description: strftime format string for the top bar clock. Uses your system locale and timezone.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to refresh the label.

key.name: only-topbar
key.description: If true, only modify the GNOME top bar DateMenu label, leaving other panels/taskbars untouched.

key.name: smooth-second
key.description: Align the first update to the next second boundary when the interval is 1s.

key.name: menu-style
key.description: Quick menu and tooltip appearance: follow the shell theme (system), or always light or dark.

key.name: bar-layout
key.description: Each entry is "kind|style|payload". Kinds: time (payload = strftime format; empty uses the global format), timer, stopwatch, weather (payload: temp, full or icon), text (payload = the text). Styles: plain, pill-neutral, pill-blue, pill-green, pill-yellow, pill-red, and auto (timer only).

key.name: popup-col2
key.description: Each entry is "id|size". Ids: clock, timer, stopwatch, weather, actions. Sizes: normal, compact. A card that is in no column is hidden.

key.name: popup-col3
key.summary: Popup cards in the right column

key.name: clock-position
key.summary: Clock position in the top bar
key.description: Where the clock sits in the top bar: center (default), next to Activities on the left, or on the right before the system icons.

key.name: lab-config
key.description: JSON with the options chosen on the Laboratório page. The lab turns them into format-string; this key only remembers the choices.

key.name: timer-sound
key.description: Play the system "complete" sound when a timer ends, besides the notification.

key.name: weather-auto-location
key.description: Turn on GNOME's automatic weather location (GeoClue) when the extension starts. Needs Location Services enabled in Settings, Privacy.

key.name: prefs-page
key.description: Set to 'about' by the popup's About button; Preferences opens that page and sets it back to 'settings'.
